title: A Semiclassical Limit of Large-Colour State Sums for Semisimple Lie Algebras
summary: The Melvin--Morton--Rozansky theorem relates the large-colour semiclassical limit of the coloured Jones polynomial to the inverse Alexander polynomial. Bar-Natan and Garoufalidis [BNG96] proved the theorem using weight systems and, more generally, established the corresponding formula for arbitrary complex semisimple Lie algebras. We give a direct proof of this semisimple Lie algebra generalization by analysing a state sum.
